subject: project:gdl
value: PARK-LAW-AGE REVISIT: the method that produced both run-15 unpark-exacts, now systematised, executed once, and calibrated with its real hit rate. METHOD (reproducible, ~10 minutes of compute): (1) parse memory_graph/records/attempts/**.json off disk rather than querying - 634 files on disk exactly equals the graph's attempt count, so the census is provably untruncated; (2) keep outcome in {parked, capped} and drop any id named by another record's `supersedes` (238 parked + 109 capped = 347 raw, far fewer live); (3) classify each park's mechanism from residual_class + residual + do_not_retry text; (4) rank by (newest applicable law recorded_at - park recorded_at). RESULT: 57 live parked/capped records carry a post-dating law, the largest gap being 1.74 days; because the five high-yield laws were all recorded late on 2026-08-31 (regnorm 17:13:14Z, inverted-guard 17:16:59Z, slot-order 17:49:02Z, inline-frame 19:01:29Z, variable-identity 19:01:33Z), essentially every park older than 2026-08-31 evening qualifies, so LAW AGE ALONE IS A WEAK RANKER - it selects ~57 candidates and cannot order them. THE STRONG RANKER IS THE LAW'S OWN PRESCRIBED MEASUREMENT, run BEFORE any probe, because it is cheap, mechanical, and falsifies the park's LABEL rather than re-litigating its axis. TWO BATCH SCREENS, both worth re-running after any law lands. SCREEN A, regnorm over all 26 live REGISTER_ONLY parks predating the regnorm law: 3 parks are STALE-SOLVED (init_player_select MATCH, CritterDoTexmodNode MATCH, InitEffects EXACT, all 0 real diff lines - integrator should delete these per parked-record hygiene); 3 are MISLABELLED with structure still hiding (GetAnimAngXYZVal 6 STRUCTURAL, WPitchMat3 2 STRUCTURAL with 0 renaming, ProcessCritter 1 STRUCTURAL); 1 more is mislabelled with a count mismatch (PointLineColl, OPERAND_DIFF over 24 lines with a bl fqdist reloc, regnorm UNPAIRED); the remaining ~19 report UNPAIRED and so were never honest REGISTER_ONLY residuals either. The blunt lesson: a REGISTER_ONLY label in this corpus is right less than half the time, and regnorm settles it in one build. SCREEN B, frame + differing-(r1)-displacement census over all 17 live frame/slot parks predating the slot law: exactly ONE has a frame delta (fn_80062A00 in game/world/gauntworld, ours 128 vs target 120, +8 - handed to inline-frame sweep lane B, units >= game/n); every other frame matches target exactly; and only THREE have any differing (r1) displacement at all (GetAnimAngXYZVal 6 words, write_shop_menu 20, sDvdReadSync 4). So the slot-order law's true live candidate set is three functions, not seventeen, and the other fourteen parks can be screened out without a single probe. CALIBRATED YIELD, stated honestly so the next agent budgets correctly: this pass produced ZERO exacts. The two functions driven to their mechanism (ProcessCritter, GetAnimAngXYZVal) both re-parked, but each re-park is strictly better founded than the one it replaces - one REFUTES its predecessor's central argument, the other REFUTES its predecessor's residual CLASS and localises a whole-function 'register web' down to a single 4-byte hole. That is the realistic product of this lane: a park-quality ratchet plus a correctly-labelled queue, with an occasional exact, NOT a reliable exact factory. THREE STANDING RULES EARNED HERE. (i) Screen the label before the axis: run regnorm on any REGISTER_ONLY park and the frame/low-gap measurement on any frame park BEFORE reading the park's prose, because a wrong label sends you down the wrong law. (ii) The inline-frame check is a two-number measurement (frame delta and min-referenced-(r1) minus 8, both sides) and it EXCLUDES far more often than it selects - GetAnimAngXYZVal appears in the inline-frame law's own image census with a 364-byte low region yet has dead-low delta 0, so census membership is NOT ownership by the sweep lanes; measure, do not infer. (iii) A park whose prose already names the exact instructions, registers and MWCC-internal choice (WPitchMat3's lfsu fold after four identical A/Bs, fn_800DBE98's transposed ready-fsubs pair) is NOT re-openable by a law that post-dates it unless the law touches THAT mechanism; law age is permission to look again, never evidence that something was missed.
